|rulings=* LS Text: A permanent pilot [[Chewbacca]] (e.g. [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] [[Chewie (The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game){{!}}Chewie]] And [[The Falcon]]) is not a [[Wookiee]] so it does not receive forfeit +2.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json swccg-card-json Dark.json], Kashyyyk (GEMP ID 2_146, commit d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab), two Light Side text rulings concerning permanent pilots and forfeiting the Wookiee aboard. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026). The original [https://web.archive.org/web/20080517024647/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/anewhope/dark/small/kashyyyk.html Decipher printed face] conditions the bonus on a Wookiee aboard; the [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf 2023 Advanced Rulebook], pp. 90 and 176, explains that permanent pilots are not characters and do not inherit character characteristics. Lookup: [https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Kashyyyk Scomp: Kashyyyk (Dark)].</ref>
* LS Text: If the [[Wookiee]] aboard is forfeited first, the starship is no longer forfeit +2 when it is forfeited afterwards (as such, the forfeit +2 text is rarely utilized).
